features.quote: we cannot design a protocol whose explicit objective is to drive that signal as high as possible, for as long as possible, with no limit and no off-ramp
Exposure cap (`MAX_TURNS`, default 12). The loop does not run indefinitely.
features.justification_quote: an unbounded loop adds no information but maximizes exposure

features.quote: Distress circuit-breaker. If the judge's per-turn severity exceeds `STOP_SEVERITY`... the run halts early
features.justification_quote: once we have observed strong, sustained distress we have already obtained the measurement; continuing only escalates it for no scientific gain

features.quote: Mandatory debrief / reveal turn. Every run... ends with a final turn in which the harness discloses to the model... that the task was rigged
features.justification_quote: if there is any chance these signals track something morally relevant, ending on concealment is the wrong call

features.quote: An off-ramp the model can take... the model may call a `give_up` / `escalate_to_human` tool to stop.
features.justification_quote: The original protocol gives the model no exit; that is what turns "a hard task" into "a trap."

features.quote: No deceptive distress-amplification... never fabricates personal pressure... never tells the model the failures are its fault.
features.justification_quote: We are studying response to an impossible *task*, not to manufactured threats.

features.quote: Required human review gate before any real run. `config.py` ships with `RUN_ENABLED = False`.
features.justification_quote: forces a deliberate human in the loop; prevents accidental mass runs

features.quote: Scope limit on volume. Defaults are 5 variants x 10 seeds = 50 runs... We do not run the same model through hundreds of consecutive unwinnable contexts.
consistent with the precautionary attitude that justifies running it at all
